parsed.post: The attempt to increase WARMUP_RATIO to 0.15 resulted in a slight regression (0.8992 vs 0.8897). It seems the model prefers a shorter warmup period. For the final round, I will try a more aggressive approach by increasing the MATRIX_LR to 0.09 and reducing WEIGHT_DECAY to see if we can squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Final attempt: slightly increase MATRIX_LR to 0.09 and keep WEIGHT_DECAY at 0.0 to maximize convergence speed in the last 5-minute window.
